messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I swear, it must have circulated back to me at least three times and I'm totally certain it was the same coin.

output.original_text: I swear, it must have circulated back to me at least three times and I'm totally certain it was the same coin.
output.joy: I can't believe it, that coin must have come back to me at least three times, and I'm so sure it was the same one!
output.sadness: I can't help but feel that the coin must have circulated back to me at least three times, and I'm just so certain it was the same one...
output.fear: I really think that coin has circulated back to me at least three times, and I'm honestly terrified it was the same one...
output.anger: I swear, that coin has come back to me at least three times, and I'm furious it was the same one!
output.surprise: I swear, it must have circled back to me at least three times, and I'm shocked it was the same coin!
output.disgust: I swear, it must have come back to me at least three times, and I find it utterly gross that it was the same coin.
